topic: Interior Lighting Sub System (Z-ONE-3.0 Platform) - Sub System Technical Specification
row_semantics: Each row represents a specific command or control signal for the interior lighting system, detailing its function, input sources, and associated parameters.

column_semantics.Input: The source or interface where the command is received (e.g., LIN bus, LHZCU module).
column_semantics.LHZCU: Lighting and Hazard Control Unit, a central controller for lighting functions.
column_semantics.CnsoAmblampB_LH: Command for ambient lamp brightness on the left-hand side.
column_semantics.LHZCU_LIN5: Specific LIN channel within the LHZCU module.
column_semantics.内灯SSTS: Internal Lighting Sub System Technical Specification reference.

core_entities.name: CnsoLHBLampColorCmd_1
core_entities.description: Command to set the color of the left-hand side ambient lamp.

core_entities.name: CnsoLHBLampBrtnsCmd_1
core_entities.description: Command to adjust the brightness of the left-hand side ambient lamp.

core_entities.name: CnsoLHBLampBrthngCmd_1
core_entities.description: Command to control the breathing rate of the left-hand side ambient lamp.

core_entities.name: LHZCU
core_entities.description: Lighting and Hazard Control Unit, responsible for processing and executing lighting commands.

core_entities.name: LIN
core_entities.description: Local Interconnect Network, used for transmitting commands between modules.

core_conditions.name: Color Value
core_conditions.description: Range from 0x00 (no request) to 0xFF (various color values).

core_conditions.name: Breathing Rate
core_conditions.description: Defined by code values from 0x0 to 0xF, corresponding to different rates in milliseconds.

core_outputs.name: Ambient Lamp Color
core_outputs.description: The selected color of the left-hand side ambient lamp.

core_outputs.name: Ambient Lamp Brightness
core_outputs.description: The adjusted brightness level of the left-hand side ambient lamp.

core_outputs.name: Ambient Lamp Breathing Rate
core_outputs.description: The rate at which the ambient lamp changes intensity in a breathing pattern.

core_timing_constraints.name: Rate0
core_timing_constraints.description: Indicates no change in the breathing rate.

core_timing_constraints.name: Rate1
core_timing_constraints.description: New breathing rate mode (0-100% intensity change every 500ms).

core_timing_constraints.name: Rate2
core_timing_constraints.description: Original breathing mode 2 (0-100% intensity change every 1 second).

engineering_interpretation: This table defines the technical specifications for controlling the left-hand side ambient lighting system, including color, brightness, and breathing rate commands. It specifies the input sources, command codes, and timing constraints for each function, enabling detailed testing of the lighting system's response to various control signals.
